newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia June inflation seen down 0.16-0.18 pct.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia June inflation seen down 0.16-0.18 pct.

text.p: Indonesia's consumer price index for June was likely to show a month-on-month fall of 0.16-0.18 percent, compared with a rise of 0.19 percent in May, government officials said on Tuesday.
The inflation rate fell 0.07 percent month-on-month in June 1996. Indonesia posted an inflation rate of 6.47 percent in calender 1996 against 8.64 percent in 1995.
The government has forecast an inflation rate of six percent for the 1997/98 fiscal year that started on April 1.
